proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hA3 : ContDiff ℝ 3 A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j := electricField_apply_contDiff_space (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) (i := j) hA3 t
  have hEd j k := Space.deriv_differentiable (hEs j) k
  have hB j := magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff (n := 2) (c := 𝓕.c) A hA3 (j, i)
  have hBt j := Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time (i := j)
    (hB j) x t
  have hs := DifferentiableAt.fun_sum (u := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => hBt j)
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable (by first |
                                      simp_all only [Finset.mem_univ, imp_self, implies_true, DifferentiableAt.fun_sum, ne_eq, WithTop.coe_eq_zero,
                                      ENat.top_ne_zero, not_false_eq_true])
  have hJt := LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
    hJd x i (c := 𝓕.c) t
  have hg := congrArg (fun f : Space d → ℝ => fderiv ℝ f x (Space.basis i))
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  simp only [div_eq_inv_mul,
    fderiv_fun_sum (fun j _ => hEd j j x), fderiv_const_mul
      (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space
        hJd t x),
    _root_.sum_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
    ← Space.deriv_eq_fderiv_basis, Space.deriv_commute (u := i) _ (hEs _)] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1, s]
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid (electricField_differentiable_time (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out) x),
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sub (hs.const_mul _) (hJt.const_mul _),
    fderiv_const_mul hs, fderiv_const_mul hJt]
  change (_ : ℝ) * ∂ₜ _ t - _ * ∂ₜ _ t = _
  simp only [Time.deriv_fun_sum Finset.univ _ (fun j _ => hBt j),
    Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (hB _),
    time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A (hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out),
    Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i _) (hEd _ i),
    Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg, FreeSpace.c_sq, div_eq_mul_inv, mul_inv_rev, one_mul, mul_sub,
    mul_comm 𝓕.μ₀⁻¹ 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹, mul_left_comm 𝓕.μ₀⁻¹ 𝓕.ε₀⁻¹, mul_assoc, inv_mul_cancel_left₀ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]
